build_fp8_linear_layer: build a pytorch Fp8Linear module that performs FP8 quantized matrix multiplication with cutlass or torch._scaled_mm
create_fp8_quantize_function: create a function that quantizes a float16 tensor to float8_e4m3fn and returns the quantized weight and inverse scale
create_hybrid_fp8_loader: create a HybridFP8UnquantLoader to load FP8 or unquantized weights from a checkpoint with optional block-wise scaling
normalize_e4m3fn_for_rocm: normalize e4m3fn float8 weights to e4m3fnuz format for ROCM hardware by fixing NaN bit patterns and doubling scales
get_fp8_linear_class: get the best FP8 linear layer class for the current GPU, falling back to Marlin on unsupported hardware
